_about: Hero vehicle parameters. hue_ranges are HSV [lo,hi] pairs of the PAINT; attach_dark_max_v/_s attach the car's dark part to it (0 = the paint covers the whole car, which is the case for a car painted at both ends). open_kernel removes specks; close_kernel joins the body's halves; min_area rejects smaller things. Re-record the front/rear template afterwards and CHECK corr(right,left) is negative.
_measured: Measured on the real car. The paint (yellow nose) is all a colour mask can see: H 24..33, S 93..138, V 115..211; 686 px facing left, 856 px facing right, position jitter +-0.14 px. The cabin is found by asking WHICH WAY from the paint it is dark, not by looking for dark pixels: beside the paint, right=78 (the cabin) against above 181, left 178, below 173 and a road at 186 - a 20:1 separation that did not move with the threshold; turned around, 180 degrees reads 102 against 171-193, a 73-level drop against a threshold of 40. Sixteen rays at 22.5 degrees, because four axis-aligned boxes work only while the car is level (a rotation sweep found that: at 15/30/45 degrees the cabin is beyond a corner). Two passes, because one is not enough: a generous probe finds the dark region and its centroid gives the car's own axis, then the region is re-cut to a band of the paint's width along that axis, and only a component touching the paint is kept. The single-pass version used a corridor of half*sqrt(area)*1.4, which came out 36.6 px across on a car 31 px tall: it swallowed the road above and below, and the box on a saved frame went from 91x31 / elongation 2.99 to 84x38 / 1.94 - shorter and stubbier. With two passes that same frame reads 85x32 / 2.70 and the turned car 83x37 / 2.21. The front is the painted end - a fact about this car, applied only when the paint covers under 80% of the car's length, because a car painted end to end has no painted end to point at. Live: 120 frames, box 82x36, elongation 2.21-2.24, cabin attached in every frame, window 60/60 pointing at the nose (error median 9 degrees, frame to frame change median 0.1) with no 180 degree flips.
